definitions.explanation: The middle point of a process or journey; neither the beginning nor the end.

examples.japanese: {中途|ちゅうと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{諦|あきら}めて→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いけない→いけない：02335_ikenai⟧。
examples.english: You must not give up halfway.

examples.japanese: {中途|ちゅうと}⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}した→入社：03131_nyuusha⟧。
examples.english: I joined the company through mid-career hiring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{中途|ちゅうと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頓挫|とんざ}した→頓挫：09065_tonza⟧。
{中途|ちゅうと}⟦{半端|はんぱ}→半端：08657_hanpa⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: You won't succeed at anything with a half-hearted attitude.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{中途|ちゅうと}⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}した→入社：03131_nyuusha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}している→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧。
examples.english: He joined the company through mid-career hiring, but has now risen to department head.

notes:
{中途|ちゅうと} means midway or halfway through a process. It often carries a connotation of incompleteness or stopping before reaching the end.

COMPOUNDS:
- {中途|ちゅうと}⟦{半端|はんぱ}→半端：08657_hanpa⟧: half-finished, halfhearted, incomplete
- {中途|ちゅうと}⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧: mid-career hiring (as opposed to ⟦{新卒|しんそつ}→新卒：12871_shinsotsu⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧)
- {中途|ちゅうと}⟦{退学|たいがく}→退学：03387_taigaku⟧: dropping out of school
- {中途|ちゅうと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{止|や}める→やめる：00909_yameru⟧: to quit halfway

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧: on the way, midway (neutral, no negative connotation)
- ⟦{半|なか}ば→半ば：03500_nakaba⟧: halfway, middle
- {中途|ちゅうと} typically implies something was left unfinished, while ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧ simply marks a point along the way

USAGE:
{中途|ちゅうと}⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧ is an important business term in Japan, where most companies traditionally hire through ⟦{新卒|しんそつ}→新卒：12871_shinsotsu⟧⟦{一括|いっかつ}→一括：08947_ikkatsu⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧ (mass hiring of new graduates).
